Это игра, которая в 2026 году по-прежнему остается королем зомби-экшенов. Techland удалось создать идеальный гибрид из паркура в духе Mirror's Edge и брутальной системы ближнего боя. Оценка «11 из 10» здесь за то, что спустя столько лет ни один конкурент так и не смог повторить эту химию.

Лучший паркур в жанре: Перемещение по Харрану - это отдельный вид искусства. Ты не просто бежишь, ты чувствуешь каждое движение, инерцию и высоту. Весь город спроектирован как гигантская игровая площадка, где крыши - твоя единственная безопасная зона.

Цикл дня и ночи: Гениальное решение, которое меняет правила игры. Днем ты - охотник, который методично зачищает улицы. Ночью ты - добыча. Появление Прыгунов превращает экшен в напряженный хоррор, от которого зашкаливает пульс.

Система расчлененки и крафта: Удары ощущаются невероятно физично. Ты чувствуешь, как труба ломает кости, а мачете отсекает конечности. Возможность собрать из хлама электрический топор или огненный меч добавляет геймплею фана и вариативности.

Атмосфера и дизайн: Харран выглядит потрясающе аутентично. От трущоб, залитых палящим солнцем, до Старого города с его европейской архитектурой - каждый район пропитан духом безнадеги и запустения.

Кооператив: Проходить историю с друзьями - это отдельный кайф. Совместные забеги по крышам, соревновательные испытания и помощь в битвах с боссами делают игру практически бесконечной.

Поддержка и DLC: Дополнение The Following с полноценной картой и багги - это пример того, какими должны быть идеальные DLC. Techland поддерживали игру контентом много лет, что сделало сообщество фанатов невероятно преданным.

Итог: Это эталонный зомби-апокалипсис. Игра дает тебе абсолютную свободу движений и заставляет искренне бояться темноты. Если ты ищешь идеальное сочетание скорости, жестокости и атмосферы - это твой выбор.

This game has a lot going for it when it comes to the general feel of running around the Harran rooftops, evading or engaging zombies, trying to avoid making noise, finding new and fun ways to take out hordes that are in your way, and rummaging through abandoned apartments and gas stations looking for loot. The controls are sharp and your actions feel visceral. It also has a great soundtrack that adds a lot to the mood of desperation.

Unfortunately I think its many flaws overshadow these better aspects.

[list][*]There are some annoying performance issues that I understand a lot of people are plagued by, myself included. The game will run 144 fps fine for a while, then drop to 20-30 for no reason, only a restart fixes it.
[*]The whole weapons & enemy balance is so unrealistic it hurts your brain. Iron pipes break after you hit a zombie ten times with it, but you can fix it with duct tape. Melee weapons increase in damage tenfold over the course of the game. Basic zombie grunts randomly get a HP boost at one point in the game so when you finally have some weapons that can take them out quick, you find yourself back to noob level damage. In a game that is supposed to immerse you in a zombie apocalypse, it feels like they tried hard to break that immersion.
[*]Scripted story events are another way they made an effort to remove the fun. Many of them will leave you with some weapons/equipment arbitrarily disabled and having to figure out the correct route while being shot at or chased by killer speed-zombies. So you die a lot just learning how to beat that particular event. Near the end you have to climb a huge radio tower and they [b]disable your grappling hook...[/b]
[*]You are equipped with "survivor sense" that makes you see night stalkers through walls. If you're going to give the character unnatural abilities, at least have an explanation for it. Or let us turn it off.
[*]While I love the choice of setting, it quickly becomes painfully obvious that it is  an American's idea of an Arab city. I dont think I've heard anyone speak Arabic at all or refer to any fundamental concepts of Arabic culture. But I've heard French, Russian, etc. And to rub it in, the highest tier food is a [b]hamburger[/b] while Arabic foods are the lower tiers. The one reference to cultural I recall is Machiavelli (because of course the bad guys need to quote him). Sigh. More great potential lost.[/list]

Some of the gameplay issues can be fixed with mods, but the core issues cannot be fully circumvented with what is currently available.

Last but not least, the story leaves a lot to be desired. There are a few nice plot moments, mostly in the side quests. I also appreciate that one of the few prominent female characters is a badass (without further explanation) and doesn't double as a romantic interest. There is a seed to a great storyline there but it was never allowed to sprout, probably because someone watered it with energy drink. There are so many plot holes, so many flat characters, and so many bad decisions. And yes, a good story is based on conflict and main characters making poor choices, but the choices made in the main story by pretty much every character are just... well, stupid. Yes, people do stupid ♥♥♥♥ in the real world, but in Dying Light, the stupidity doesn't make sense based on their background.

[spoiler]We have a presumably elite operative who starts out his visit to the quarantine zone by blindly following the utterly dumbass order to burn a bunch of Antazin, the suppressant that keeps the infected from turning into zombies. There are ten ways I could think of right away to "force an encounter with Rais" without being a murderous ♥♥♥♥. Hell, Kyle could just have stashed the Antazin temporarily then fetched it a little later. And this dumbass decision then affects [b]the whole story[/b]. So much death and suffering could have been avoided. Of course, Kyle then preceeds to just walk into blatant trap/setups throughout the game, as if getting caught with his pants down is his hobby. There are many more issues, but I am too tired to write more about it now, and you probably don't want to read more.[/spoiler]


I have half a mind to re-write the story into something more believable and engaging.

Anyway, my verdict is that I cannot recommend this game other than at a deep discount, and only for the purpose of trying out the free-roam zombie dodging parkour.

Dying Light est un superbe jeu, que ce soit en solo ou en coopération avec un ami. L’ambiance est particulièrement pesante et réussit parfaitement à plonger le joueur dans cet univers rempli de zombies et de dangers. L’histoire est mémorable, mais ce qui rend le jeu encore meilleur, c’est tout ce qu’il propose autour de sa campagne principale.

La map ouverte est grande et remplie d’activités : défis, parcours en parkour, exploration, combats contre les zombies… Il y a toujours quelque chose à faire et le jeu reste constamment amusant à parcourir. Le système de déplacement est excellent et rend chaque session vraiment dynamique.

Le DLC apporte aussi énormément au jeu avec l’ajout des véhicules, ce qui change complètement la manière de jouer et d’explorer la map. Les nids de rapaces, les sorties nocturnes avec davantage d’XP à gagner, mais aussi le risque permanent de se faire poursuivre si l’on se fait repérer, rendent l’expérience encore plus intense et stressante. Franchement, tout cela est magistral, surtout en coopération.

Absolutely legendary zombie game, basically a classic at this point. 

-Gameplay. One of the best I've ever had an honor to experience. Melee combat is great and juicy, gunplay isn't that great, but it gets a pass. Parkour is outstanding, definitely one of the best there is. Leveling is surprisingly good, most of the perks are great and you really want to level up. Also I really recommend to complete the game solo and in coop. Coop is absolutely great here(Well, it was basically designed with the coop in mind).

-Story it's ok. I don't really care about the cast, they are not that  great, but protagonist and antagonist are actually good and it's interesting to listen to them. Rais(antagonist) actually has a lot of  funny bits of dialogue, so It's worth to play just to listen to them. I want to give cudos to voice actors, cause their work really elevates the experience, especially Crane''s. Side quests are not that special, you will mostly do them for the experience points.

-OST. There aren't any tracks that are really memorable, but they set the atmosphere and do their job, so no complaints here.

-Graphics. A bit outdated, but zombies' art direction is great and atmosphere(especially in the prologue) is outstanding. Beginning of the game is just another experience entirely, because you are actually afraid of zombies and a night. Later you become an overpowered beast, and it's great, but it's another experience.

-Technical Issues. Didn't experience any issues. It runs great, and maybe I've seen a couple of serious bugs, but it usually resolves by a restart.

10/10, masterpiece of a game. Also I want to give my thanks to the developers for still supporting the game after all these years. Buy for the full price with the friend and enjoy.

Из всех частей Dying Light эта — моя любимая. По нескольким причинам:
1. В первой части чувствуется та самая атмосфера угнетения и мёртвого города, что подкрепляется прекрасным саундтреком.
2. Как я и сказал ранее, саундтрек в этой игре прекрасен, его можно переслушивать бесконечно, особенно трек «Horizon».
3. Боёвка здесь необычная. Если сравнить со второй частью Dying Light, где надо просто закликивать врага, здесь она более реалистичная. Например, если подойти к противнику в упор, Крейн не сможет пронзить его оружием и будет бить сбоку. А если чуть-чуть отойти и ударить по шее, то с большим шансом голова отлетит.
4. Ну и последнее — это паркур. Он здесь классный, им вы будете пользоваться почти всегда, чтобы обходить кучи зомби и пробираться в труднодоступные места. Игра, по мне, прямо топ. Хоть она и 2015 года выпуска, всё равно очень крутая.

Dying Light 2 (after the numerous fixes made to DL2; it was not good at launch lmao) solves a lot of this, but at the cost of the vibes, which are immaculate here, but pretty milquetoast over there. So now you have to choose: do you want a seamlessly fun game where the difficulty and hurdles don't feel unintended or poorly telegraphed? Well, you have to play the "worse" DL game because Villador feels so flaccid by comparison to Harran. Do you want the immaculate vibes of Harran? Please, God, make DL3 a genuinely great game, better than DL1/2/The Beast (which is more or less DL2.5).

核心优点
 
- 跑酷体验顶级，流畅度拉满

- 昼夜循环改变玩法，恐怖感十足
白天搜集、跑酷、清弱丧尸；入夜后“夜魔”（Volatile）出没，速度快、伤害高，必须躲安全屋或极限逃生，紧张感直接拉满 。
- 近战打击感炸裂，武器系统丰富
钝器/锐器/枪械手感扎实，断肢、爆头、血溅效果夸张；武器可搜刮+打造+附魔+耐久度管理，神器（如K刀）一刀一个，后期可玩成“爽游”。
- 开放世界内容扎实，重复游玩价值高
哈兰城地图紧凑、细节足，支线有深度、有道德抉择；跑酷挑战、解谜、彩蛋、DLC（如《信徒》）量大质高，百小时不重样。
- 4人联机合作，乐趣翻倍
可随时加入/退出，一起跑酷、刷装备、打Boss、闯暗区，容错更高、欢乐更多 。
 
️ 明显缺点
 
- 剧情中规中矩，老套无惊喜
主线是“特工找病毒+人性抉择”，套路化、角色单薄、反转好猜，属于“能玩但记不住”的水平 。
- 前期难度陡峭，新手易劝退
开局资源少、武器脆、丧尸强、夜魔秒杀；死了回最近安全屋，跑酷失误惩罚重 。
- 后期玩法略单调，刷刷刷明显
成型后（神装+满技能），白天割草、晚上躲夜魔，重复跑图刷材料；快速传送少，长距离跑路多。
- 优化与小Bug，十年仍有残留
老机器可能掉帧、卡顿；偶发穿墙、卡模型、安全屋刷丧尸、昼夜卡死等问题，需重启解决。
 
总评与适合人群
 
总分：8.5/10（经典神作，瑕不掩瑜）
- 一句话总结：跑酷+丧尸+昼夜恐怖的巅峰融合，玩法扎实、氛围到位、联机好玩，剧情和后期重复度是主要短板 。
- 适合：喜欢《镜之边缘》跑酷、《死亡岛》近战、末日求生、联机合作的玩家。
- 不适合：怕高、晕3D、讨厌丧尸、追求深度剧情、讨厌刷刷刷的玩家。
 
对比与选购建议
 
- 同系列：1代（2015）> 2代（2022）> 困兽（2025）；1代昼夜恐怖最强、跑酷最纯粹 。
- 入手建议：先玩1代+《信徒》DLC，折扣时极低；喜欢再入2代或等《困兽》完整版 。
